guitar.evidence: Extremely well-documented: B.B. King's guitar was named Lucille, primarily a Gibson ES-355 (and later Gibson's own "Lucille" signature model based on the ES-355).
guitar.notes: Original entry is correct and iconic.

tone.target: clean late-blues lead with smooth sustain and wide vibrato
tone.profile: clean late-blues lead with smooth sustain and wide vibrato
tone.summary: A classic Fender-style chain using light compression, a subtle boost/overdrive for edge, US Deluxe amp model, and a 2x12 cab to capture the warm, singing late-blues sound of B.B. King.

rig.name: B.B. King - The Thrill Is Gone - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide gentle clean amp edge and sustain lift without heavy crunch.
blocks.gap: The Boost module is used to simulate the light grit/edge often found in vintage blues tones, replacing a dedicated low-gain OD pedal.

blocks.purpose: Keep the signal clean and focused on natural amp tone.
blocks.gap: No dedicated distortion needed; the Boost module provides sufficient edge.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the clean, warm, and articulate tone of a Fender-style vintage amplifier.
Provide a bright, articulate, and classic American clean tone suitable for blues leads.
Enhance the warm mid-focus and round off the high end for vocal clarity.
blocks.gap: Used to manually sculpt the frequency response, emphasizing the 'singing' quality of the lead lines.

blocks.purpose: Add a subtle width and 'wide vibrato' effect to the sustained notes.
blocks.gap: Chorus is used instead of dedicated Vibrato/Tremolo to achieve the required wide, smooth pitch modulation without sounding artificial.

blocks.purpose: Provide subtle space and warmth (spring reverb simulation) without muddying the clean tone.
blocks.gap: Room reverb is chosen over Spring/Plate for a more natural, less metallic decay that complements the vintage blues sound.

blocks.purpose: Optional: Used for rhythmic accents if needed, but kept off to maintain focus on the core clean tone.
blocks.gap: Not strictly necessary for this specific blues style, so it is deactivated by default.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR to enhance mid-range focus and natural cabinet resonance.

proposals.reason: Enhance warm, focused mid-range for B.B. King's vocal lead tone.
proposals.expectedGain: Improved clarity and warmth in the upper mids.
